html:
A civil war from March 1991 to January 2002, begun when the Revolutionary United Front (RUF) of Foday Sankoh invaded from Liberia with the backing of Charles Taylor.

The RUF used child soldiers and cut off the hands and arms of civilians to spread terror, and fought for control of the diamond fields. Coups, mercenaries, Nigerian-led West African troops and civil defence militias joined in. Rebels attacked Freetown in January 1999. A large UN force and British troops, sent in 2000, helped end the war, which killed about 50,000 people and displaced half the population. The Special Court tried its leaders. See also the Liberian war.
sum: A civil war from March 1991 to January 2002, begun when the Revolutionary United Front (RUF) of Foday Sankoh invaded from Liberia with the backing of Charles Taylor.
